query:
SELECT custom_id,
                       endpoint AS "endpoint!",
                       method AS "method!",
                       path AS "path!",
                       body AS "body!",
                       model AS "model!",
                       api_key AS "api_key!",
                       line_number AS "line_number!"
                FROM request_templates
                WHERE file_id = $1 AND ($2 = -1 OR line_number > $2)
                  AND ($5::text IS NULL OR LOWER(custom_id) LIKE $5)
                ORDER BY line_number ASC
                OFFSET $3
                LIMIT $4
